name: Computer Graphics Programming
summary: Computer graphics programming reference: rasterization pipeline, model/view/projection transforms and coordinate spaces, rasterization vs Whitted/path ray tracing, Phong/PBR/BRDF lighting, texturing/mipmaps, depth & culling, OpenGL/Vulkan/WebGPU tradeoffs, GLSL stages, and matrix-order/handedness/gamma/z-fighting gotchas.
